readme:
medium-zoom

Lightweight image zoom for the web. Zero dependencies, any framework, React via shadcn.

Website · Documentation · React

[![An image opening with medium-zoom](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6137112/43369906-7623239a-9376-11e8-978b-6e089be499fb.gif)](https://medium-zoom.francoischalifour.com)
## JavaScript Install the package: ```sh npm install medium-zoom ``` Add an image to your page: ```html ``` After the image is in the document, initialize the zoom: ```js import mediumZoom from 'medium-zoom' mediumZoom('[data-zoomable]') ``` The standard import includes styles and TypeScript definitions. Click the image to zoom. Click again, press esc, or scroll to close it. The [JavaScript quickstart](https://medium-zoom.francoischalifour.com/docs/javascript/) covers script tags, separate stylesheets, and browser support. See the [API reference](https://medium-zoom.francoischalifour.com/docs/reference/javascript/medium-zoom/) for selectors, options, methods, and events. ## React In a project configured for [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com), install the component: ```sh npx shadcn@latest add @medium-zoom/image-zoom ``` ```tsx import { ImageZoom } from '@/components/ui/image-zoom' export function Photo() { return } ``` The command copies the component and stylesheet into your project and installs `medium-zoom`. The component provides a keyboard-accessible button and manages zoom state and cleanup. Follow the [React quickstart](https://medium-zoom.francoischalifour.com/docs/react/) or use the [component reference](https://medium-zoom.francoischalifour.com/docs/reference/react/image-zoom/) to customize it. ## Guides and examples The [documentation](https://medium-zoom.francoischalifour.com/docs/) covers HD images, galleries, styling, and the JavaScript and React APIs. Runnable [examples](examples/) include [plain JavaScript](examples/vanilla), [React](examples/react), [Angular](examples/angular), [Vue](examples/vue), [Svelte](examples/svelte), [Astro](examples/astro), and [VitePress](examples/vitepress). The React example demonstrates using the library directly; [shadcn/ui](examples/shadcn) demonstrates the installable component. ## Contributing See [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup, development commands, verification, and releases. To work on the website, see its [development guide](website/README.md). ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © [François Chalifour](https://francoischalifour.com)

scripts.examples: bun run build:website && vite preview --config config/vite.website.config.mts --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173
scripts.build:website: bun run build && bun run build:demo
scripts.deploy:website: bun run build:website && wrangler deploy --config config/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.preview:website: bun run build:website && wrangler dev --config config/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.build:demo: bun run build:registry && bun run --cwd website build && bun run build:stories && bun run build:examples
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src scripts tests stories/catalogue config website/worker.ts website/src website/build *.mts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd website typecheck && bun scripts/check-docs.ts && bun run typecheck:examples && bun run typecheck:registry
scripts.check: bun run check:library && bun run build:demo && bun run test:examples && bun run test:browser && bun run test:rsc && bun run test:analytics && bun run test:registry
scripts.check:library: bun run check:source && bun run test:size && bun run test:package
scripts.check:source: bun run format:check && bun run build && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.test:docs: bun scripts/check-docs.ts && bun run test:browser website-docs.spec.ts website-hierarchy.spec.ts
scripts.typecheck:registry: mkdir -p .cache && wrangler types .cache/worker-types.d.ts --config config/wrangler.jsonc && tsc --noEmit -p config/tsconfig.worker.json
